title: Impact input validation
responsibility: Validates impact graph shapes and graph integrity in the fixed order shared by runtime implementations.

inputs.name: kernelRequest.input
inputs.description: The untrusted value to validate as an impact input. It must be a non-array object with `base` and `head` graphs (`nodes` as string arrays and `edges` as arrays of exactly two nonnegative integers), plus string arrays `changed`, `uncertain`, and `sinks`; extra fields are ignored.

inputs.name: isObject.value
inputs.description: The value passed to the object guard. It returns false for null, arrays, primitives, and functions, and true for other non-null objects regardless of prototype.

outputs.name: kernelRequest
outputs.description: A `Parsed<ImpactInput>` result, with `{value}` on success and `{error}` carrying `invalid-request` or `invalid-graph`; successful values keep only `base`, `head`, `changed`, `uncertain`, and `sinks`, and graphs keep only `nodes` and `edges`. Shape checks run for base then head then `changed`, `uncertain`, and `sinks`, followed by base-before-head integrity checks that report repeated nodes before out-of-range edges.

outputs.name: isObject
outputs.description: A boolean type guard for `Fields` (`Record<string, unknown>`). It returns true for any non-null, non-array object without checking its prototype, and false for arrays, primitives, functions, and null.
